verdict.rationale: The only first-party SDK in the evidence is Adyen's fraud data collection SDK, which you can add to website pages. That is a narrow client-side integration, not a general-purpose server or API SDK for building against risk management. The OpenAPI definitions repo is a developer building block that earns no credit here. Missing for 10: official language SDKs or client libraries for the risk, Referrals and Disputes APIs; SDK reference docs; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
